subject: history_social
passage: On December 28, 1895, the brothers Auguste and Louis Lumière showed ten short films to a paying audience in the basement of a café in Paris, using a machine of their own design that could both record and project moving pictures. The ______ screening lasted only about twenty minutes, yet within months their machine was being shown in cities around the world.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The screening was put on by the two brothers, so a plural possessive is needed. A plural noun ending in s takes only an apostrophe: "brothers'."
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Brothers" has no apostrophe, so it does not show that the screening was theirs.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Brother's" is a singular possessive, but the text speaks of two brothers.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Brothers's" is not a standard form; a plural ending in s takes only an apostrophe.
explanation.D: Correct. "Brothers'" is the plural possessive, matching "the brothers Auguste and Louis Lumière."
